notes: Always rewrite the job URL to the embed form before touching it. The React board page hides fields; the embed endpoint exposes all of them with stable ids.
Option lists MUST be read scoped to the field's own listbox via aria-controls. The phone country-code dropdown lives permanently in the DOM and will poison a global [role=option] query.
Field ids ending in --0 belong to the first education row. A second degree would be --1.

gh_jid_rewrite._why: Company-site links (?gh_jid=) embed the form in an iframe; fill.py timed out on every field (Company C, 2026-09-29).
